label: cash flow
definition: the movement of money from some source to some sink

label: cash flow structure
definition: the structure related to one or more cash flows

label: triggering event
definition: event that relates to or triggers some aspect of a credit default swap

label: amount of money
definition: amount of readily available cash in banknotes and coins

label: currency
definition: medium of exchange value, defined by reference to the geographical location of the monetary authorities responsible for it

label: currency basket
definition: selected group of currencies, in which the weighted average is used as a measure of the value or the amount of an obligation

label: currency identifier
definition: sequence of characters representing some currency

label: exchange rate
definition: rate at which one currency can be exchanged for another

label: funds
definition: artificial currency used as calculation basis for another currency(s) and accounting purposes

label: funds identifier
definition: sequence of characters that can be used to uniquely identify funds

label: association
definition: not-for-profit organization that is owned by and acts on behalf of its members

label: cooperative society
definition: organization owned by and operated for the benefit of those using its services

label: family office
definition: organization that assumes the day-to-day administration and management of a family's affairs

label: functional business entity
definition: functional entity defined in terms of the nature of the commercial activity it conducts

label: functional entity
definition: party defined in terms of a function they or it performs

label: merchant
definition: party engaged in the purchase and sales of goods produced by others for profit

label: merchant category code
definition: code used internationally to classify a merchant

label: merchant category code scheme
definition: scheme defining a set of codes for classifying merchant services

label: merchant identifier
definition: unique identifier for a merchant that is used, for example, for transaction interchange purposes

label: syndicate
definition: temporary, self-organizing group of people, companies, corporations or entities organized as an alliance whose purpose is to transact some specific business, or to pursue or promote a shared interest

label: bankruptcy
definition: credit event involving a change in state or condition in which a party becomes insolvent

label: credit event
definition: event signifying a sudden change in credit standing, such as bankruptcy or a violation of a bond indenture or loan agreement, that raises doubts about the party's ability to meet current or future obligations

label: cross default provision
definition: contract provision that triggers a default under one contract if the borrower defaults on another related obligation

label: default event
definition: credit event representing a failure to meet a contractual obligation, such as failure to repay a debt including interest or principal on a loan or security

label: distressed ratings downgrade
definition: credit event triggered when the credit rating of an obligation is downgraded to a distressed debt level

label: downgrade
definition: credit event triggered when the credit rating of a party or obligation is lowered

label: entity-specific credit event
definition: credit event that applies to a given legal person

label: failure to pay
definition: default event that is triggered following any applicable grace period in which a payment obligation is missed

label: failure to pay interest
definition: default event that where either an expected interest payment is missed altogether or the amount paid is less than the required amount

label: failure to pay principal
definition: default event that where either an expected principal payment is missed altogether or the amount paid is less than the required amount

label: auto asset-backed security
definition: asset-backed security that is backed by an underlying pool of auto-related loans and/or leases

label: auto debt pool
definition: debt pool of loans and/or leases that are motor vehicle-related

label: bond pool
definition: debt pool of consisting of bonds

label: consumer asset-backed security
definition: structured finance securities collateralized by pools of auto loans and leases (auto ABS), credit card receivables (credit card ABS) or student loans (student loan ABS)

label: controlled amortization asset-backed security
definition: asset-backed security based on a pool of bonds securitized using a controlled amortization structure

label: credit card account pool
definition: pool of credit card receivables associated with designated accounts

label: credit card asset-backed security
definition: asset-backed security based on credit card receivables

label: fully amortizing asset-backed security
definition: asset-backed security based on a pool of debt instruments that returns principal to investors over the life of the security

label: home equity line of credit pool
definition: debt pool consisting of home equity loans

label: home equity loan asset-backed security
definition: asset-backed security based on home equity loan receivables

label: asset-backed credit default swap
definition: credit default swap whose underlying reference obligation is an asset-backed security rather than corporate credit

label: basket credit default swap
definition: credit default swap that references a bespoke, synthetic portfolio of underlying assets whose components have been agreed to for a specific OTC derivative by the parties to the transaction

label: basket of credit default swaps
definition: basket of reference obligations are credit default swap instruments

label: cash settlement method
definition: strategy for calculating or otherwise establishing a reference final price for the contract

label: contingent credit default swap
definition: credit default swap in which an additional triggering event is required

label: credit default swap
definition: bilateral contract in which one party (protection seller) agrees to provide payment to the other party (protection buyer) should a credit event occur against the underlying, which could be a specified debt (the reference obligation), a specific debt issuer (reference entity), a basket of reference entities and/or reference obligations, or a credit index (reference index)

label: credit default swap index
definition: index whose underlying reference obligations are credit default swap instruments

label: credit event notice
definition: irrevocable written or verbal notice that states that a triggering event has occurred

label: credit protection terms
definition: legal terms that define triggering events and associated conditions related to settlement

label: deliverable asset
definition: asset that must be delivered as a part of the process of settling a credit default swap
